subject: Error during spatial segmentation using spatially-aware k-means clustering

messages.author: bb4a45d0dd2b038e
messages.subject: Error during spatial segmentation using spatially-aware k-means clustering
parts:
I followed the steps described in the vignette on bioconductor. When doing the following command:

data2.skmg <- spatialKMeans(data2, r = c(1, 2), k = c(5, 10), method = "gaussian")

I got the following error message:

Error in kmeans(fastmap$scores, centers = k, iter.max = iter.max, nstart = nstart,  :
  more cluster centers than distinct data points.

Do you know the reason for it?

Many thanks
qs

messages.author: bb4a45d0dd2b038e
messages.subject: Re: Error during spatial segmentation using spatially-aware k-means clustering
parts: However, this error only occurs when using "gaussian" method. When using "adaptive" --> it works.
